summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding the visualization of a progress bar used to track performance against a set plan. The current setup uses a gray background for the plan and a colored inner bar (dynamic color from red at 0% to green at 100%) for actual achievement.

The core question raised was how to visually represent the situation when the actual performance exceeds the initial forecast/plan, as the current visualization method is insufficient. Someone working on the visualization promised to provide several options by the next day.
decisions: The need for a clearer visual representation of plan overachievement was identified.
action_items: [p2] will present multiple visualization options for the progress bar tomorrow.
